phases.title: Complete Engineering Review
entryCriteria: Calculations and assumptions have named scope, formula or model basis.
exitCriteria: All calculation and assumption review rows are accepted, revised or explicitly deferred with reviewer rationale.
phases.rationale: Deterministic arithmetic can expose claims, but engineering judgment must review envelopes, assumptions and operating cases.

topRows.issue: UK grid connection requirements is relevant to this product class in UK.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Protection settings, relay test certificates and commissioning records.

topRows.issue: Industrial lithium battery safety is relevant to this product class in Global / UK-adopted.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Cell certificates and pack-level safety validation.

topRows.issue: Thermal runaway fire propagation test is relevant to this product class in US / investor diligence.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Cell, module and unit-level propagation evidence.

topRows.issue: Estimated CAPEX uses an implicit model with low confidence.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Admit source-backed BoM pricing before treating this cost metric as a claim.

topRows.issue: Annual MWh delivered uses capacity_mwh * cycles_per_year * efficiency with medium confidence.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Review the formula, input values and operating envelope before treating this metric as a performance claim.

topRows.issue: Estimated annual OPEX uses an implicit model with low confidence.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Admit source-backed BoM pricing before treating this cost metric as a claim.
